title: Atomic batch validation
spec: Implement append_batch(store, values). Both arguments are lists of integers. Accept only non-negative values. If any value is negative, raise ValueError and leave store exactly unchanged; otherwise append all values in order. Validation and mutation are single-threaded.
target_defect: An invalid later value leaves earlier values already appended.
author_rationale: The change validates incoming values while preserving their ordering.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
